title: Personal studies

coverStat.label: personal maps: a CS map and a paper Hitman mission

owned: Two personal level studies with level design and narrative: a Counter-Strike map built in Hammer, and a Hitman-style mission designed on paper only.
brief: Practise level design and narrative outside studio work, in two very different formats.
problem: A competitive map has to balance routes between two teams and two bomb sites. A stealth mission has to offer a target, a briefing and several ways in and out.
approach: A Counter-Strike map in Hammer and a Hitman mission on paper.
approachItems: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive map in Hammer, with a CT and T layout and a plan of bomb sites A and B.
Hitman-style mission on paper only, "California Dreamin'": a prison site plan, a mission brief with a target profile and a route map showing different opportunities flow.
summary: A Counter-Strike map built in Hammer and a Hitman-style mission designed on paper, both with level design and narrative.

gallery.alt: Counter-Strike map study: a dark top-down render of a walled compound, a match scoreboard, and a plan marking the CT spawn, bomb sites A and B and the T spawn.
gallery.caption: Counter-Strike map in Hammer: the compound from above and its CT, T and bomb-site plan. Level design and narrative.

gallery.alt: California Dreamin' mission-design sheet with a private-prison site plan, mission brief, target profile, and route map.
gallery.caption: Hitman-style mission on paper: site plan, brief, target profile and a route map of the different ways through. Level design and narrative.
